newsitem.title: JAPAN: GOLF-SCORES FROM FINAL ROUND OF SUMITOMO TAIHEIYO.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-SCORES FROM FINAL ROUND OF SUMITOMO TAIHEIYO.

text.p: Final scores in the Sumitomo Taiheiyo Masters golf tournament at the Taiheiyo Club in Gotemba on Sunday (the event was reduced from four rounds to three because of fog which ruled out play on Saturday; players Japanese unless stated):
206 Lee Westwood (Britain) 68 70 68 (winner of a three-way playoff), Jeff Sluman (U.S.) 69 69 68, Costantino Rocca (Italy) 69 69 68
208 Yoshinori Kaneko 71-70-67, Hidiyuki Sato 68 70 70, Larry Mize (U.S.) 71 67 70
210 Peter Senior (Australia) 70 73 67, Yoshinori Mizumaki 69 72 69, Masanobu Kimura 73 66 71
211 Brandt Jobe (U.S.) 73 70 68, Seiki Okuda 75 67 69, Seve Ballesteros (Spain) 72 70 69, Shigeki Maruyama 68 72 71, Hideki Kase 70 70 71
213 Katsunori Kuwabara 71 75 67, Peter McWhinney (Australia) 69 77 67, Craig Parry (Australia) 68 73 72, Koki Idoki 73 67 73
